nextSlice.title: Create a clean-install release package and compatibility evidence
scope: Build a deterministic release archive from a clean staged plugin source tree
Exclude development caches, tests, host runtime, generated Demo assets, and local absolute paths from the distributable
Generate a version manifest, file inventory, license notice, and SHA-256 checksums
Validate fresh project installation, plugin enablement, Editor startup, panel registration, and a minimal real-host audit
Document install, upgrade, uninstall, supported host evidence, and known compatibility boundaries
nonGoals: No Marketplace submission or signing in this slice
No asset mutation or automatic repair
No AI or PCG feature expansion
No compatibility claim beyond hosts actually tested
No copying generated Engine-derived Demo uasset binaries into the release archive
validationCommands: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check Content/Python Demo/Scripts tests scripts
nextSlice.evidenceCeiling: Archive inspection may prove package contents and determinism; only installation into a fresh independent Unreal project followed by Editor startup and a real audit may prove installability. Testing UE 5.8.1 does not prove other engine versions.
acceptance: Two release builds from the same clean source produce identical inventory and payload hashes
The distributable contains only runtime-required plugin files plus version, license, and checksum metadata
UE 5.8 BuildPlugin succeeds from the staged source
A fresh independent UE 5.8 project loads the packaged plugin, registers the Chinese panel, and completes a minimal real audit
Install, upgrade, uninstall, supported versions, known limits, and Demo regeneration are documented in Chinese
README links the verified release artifact and does not overclaim Marketplace readiness or cross-version compatibility
